requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3, the lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible.
requirements.reason: Lighting and signalling devices integrated in the bumper must keep working and visible after impact.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, if the adjustment of the factory-fitted lighting devices has been disturbed, it may be corrected to conform to the required specifications only if this can be done by the normal means of adjustment.
requirements.reason: Lighting and signalling devices integrated in the bumper must keep working and visible after impact.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.reason: Whole-vehicle closures requirement; the bumper is only indirectly concerned (the bonnet may interface with it).

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.
requirements.reason: Whole-vehicle closures requirement; the bumper is only indirectly concerned (the bonnet may interface with it).

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning.
requirements.reason: Fuel and cooling systems must remain intact after impact; the bumper has the grill, airflow management and EV charge port/fuel filler cap, and must not damage these systems.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the sealing devices and caps of the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.reason: Fuel and cooling systems must remain intact after impact; the bumper has the grill, airflow management and EV charge port/fuel filler cap, and must not damage these systems.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with annex 3, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.
requirements.reason: Propulsion, suspension, steering and braking must remain operational after impact; the exemption for driver assist sensors and cameras applies to the bumper's integrated sensors.

requirements.text: Sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems are exempt from the requirement on propulsion, suspension, steering and braking systems and may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3, as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.
requirements.reason: Propulsion, suspension, steering and braking must remain operational after impact; the exemption for driver assist sensors and cameras applies to the bumper's integrated sensors.

requirements.text: In the low-speed-impact test the vehicle shall be at rest.
requirements.reason: Vehicle state during low-speed impact test.

requirements.text: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device.
requirements.reason: Impact contact geometry relative to the protective device (bumper).

requirements.text: In the two vehicle-loading conditions the protective device between the corners, as defined in paragraph 3.1.5. of this Regulation, shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line.
requirements.reason: Impact contact geometry relative to the protective device (bumper).

requirements.text: For the longitudinal impacts on the front and rear surfaces, the location of the impactor for the first impact is free, but for the second impact the median plane of the impactor shall be at a distance of at least 300 mm from the first, provided that during these impacts the extremities of the impactor do not pass outside a zone defined by two planes parallel to the longitudinal median plane and passing through the corners of the vehicle.
requirements.reason: Impact location rule for the front longitudinal impacts on the bumper.

requirements.text: In the longitudinal impact test, the impactor shall be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal at the reference height of 445 mm.
requirements.reason: Impactor setup for the longitudinal impact test.

requirements.text: In the longitudinal impact test, the vehicle should be aligned so that a point between the vehicle corners touches, but does not move, the impactor, the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle being perpendicular to plane A of the impactor.
requirements.reason: Vehicle alignment for the longitudinal impact test.

requirements.text: In the longitudinal impact test, the vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 4 km/h +0.25/-0.
requirements.reason: Impact speed for the longitudinal test.

requirements.text: In the corner impact test, plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.reason: Vehicle alignment conditions for the corner impact test.

requirements.text: In the corner impact test, the vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h +0.1/-0.
requirements.reason: Impact speed for the corner test.

requirements.text: If the test has been carried out at an impact speed or with an impact mass exceeding those indicated in paragraphs 2.7.5. and 2.8.4., and the vehicle has satisfied the conditions prescribed, the test is considered satisfactory.
requirements.reason: Acceptance rule for tests carried out above the prescribed impact speed or mass.

requirements.text: The primary reference marks (holes, surfaces, marks and identification signs on the vehicle body) shall be within ± 25 mm of the design position in the vertical (Z) axis.
requirements.reason: Definition of reference marks with shall-clauses on tolerance and vehicle position during tests; vehicle-level, bumper is only a part.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of less than 425 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1 (lower legform to bumper) shall be applied to the front bumper.
requirements.reason: Selects which bumper legform test applies by lower bumper height; the front bumper is the tested part and its height is unknown.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height greater than or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm, the requirements of either paragraph 4.1.1 or paragraph 4.1.2, at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied to the front bumper.
requirements.reason: Selects which bumper legform test applies by lower bumper height; the front bumper is the tested part and its height is unknown.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height greater than or equal to 500 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.2 (upper legform to bumper) shall be applied to the front bumper.
requirements.reason: Selects which bumper legform test applies by lower bumper height; the front bumper is the tested part and its height is unknown.

requirements.text: To verify compliance with the performance requirements of paragraph 5.1.1 (lower legform to bumper, where applicable by lower bumper height), both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1 and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.1 shall be used.
requirements.reason: Lower legform to bumper test; applies to the bumper when its lower bumper height makes 4.1.1 applicable.

requirements.text: To verify compliance with the performance requirements of paragraph 5.1.2 (upper legform to bumper, where applicable by lower bumper height), both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.2 and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.2 shall be used.
requirements.reason: Upper legform to bumper test; applies to the bumper when its lower bumper height makes 4.1.2 applicable.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1 (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.reason: Distinct, individually testable bumper pedestrian-impact performance limit under UN GTR 9.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1 (flexible lower legform to bumper), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.reason: Distinct, individually testable bumper pedestrian-impact performance limit under UN GTR 9.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
requirements.reason: Lower legform to bumper limits apply to the front bumper system.

requirements.text: The manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total only where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment does not exceed 380 Nm.
requirements.reason: Lower legform to bumper limits apply to the front bumper system.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
requirements.reason: Upper legform to bumper limits apply to the front bumper.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
requirements.reason: Upper legform to bumper limits apply to the front bumper.

requirements.text: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle (such as pedestrian impact sensors) shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
requirements.reason: The bumper has pedestrian impact sensors, which are devices designed to protect vulnerable road users.

requirements.text: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.
requirements.reason: Components that change shape or position must comply in each fixed position; may apply to bumper parts such as the towing cover or charge port cover.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.
requirements.reason: Target point selection for the legform to bumper test.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the flexible lower legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.reason: Impact velocity for the lower legform test.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the tibia bending moments shall not exceed ± 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
requirements.reason: Limit on tibia bending moment prior to impact (validity criterion).

requirements.text: In the upper legform to bumper test, the selected target points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 3.10.
requirements.reason: Target point selection for the upper legform test.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.reason: Impact velocity for the upper legform test.

requirements.text: If all prerequisites are met, the vehicle shall be tested with the DPPS activated as intended for the entire headform test area.
requirements.reason: Sets the test principle for deployable pedestrian protection systems, which the bumper may contain only as an option (pedestrian impact sensors are listed).

requirements.text: If any of the prerequisites from paragraphs 1.2 to 1.7 of Annex 1 are not met, the vehicle shall be tested with the DPPS in the undeployed position.
requirements.reason: Defines when the DPPS is tested undeployed; relevant only if the bumper has a DPPS.

requirements.text: For the system deployment verification, sensor activation tests with the FlexPLI, as specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. of this Regulation, shall be performed within the detection test area at the DPPS lower deployment velocity threshold.
requirements.reason: Sensor activation verification test for DPPS.

requirements.text: The ESA sample(s) submitted for approval shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.reason: Marking of ESA samples with trade name and type designation applies to the electronic parts of the bumper if approved as ESA.

requirements.text: An approval mark as described in paragraph 5.3 shall be affixed to every electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation; no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.reason: Marking of ESA; the bumper's electronics could be approved as ESA, but this is uncertain.

requirements.text: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.reason: General rule that the vehicle and its electrical/electronic systems or ESAs be designed and fitted to comply; the bumper with its sensors and electronics is an ESA or part of the vehicle system.

requirements.text: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.reason: ESAs must be tested for emissions and immunity; the bumper's electronics (sensors, heated radar, lighting) may be ESAs.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type (where the bumper system contains electrical/electronic sub-assemblies) shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.reason: Broadband emission measurement method for the ESA; applies via the electronic parts of the bumper.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6.
requirements.reason: Broadband emission limits for ESAs; the bumper has electronic parts (sensors, lighting).

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the broadband limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.reason: Broadband emission limits for ESAs; the bumper has electronic parts (sensors, lighting).

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.reason: Pass criterion for ESA broadband emission.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.reason: Narrowband emission measurement method for the ESA.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.reason: Narrowband emission limits for ESAs.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the narrowband limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.reason: Narrowband emission limits for ESAs.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.reason: Pass criterion for ESA narrowband emission.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances of the ESA representative of its type on 12/24 V supply lines shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.reason: Transient emission test for ESAs on supply lines; bumper has powered electronics.

requirements.text: The maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems.
requirements.reason: Table of maximum pulse amplitudes inherits the obligation of the parent.

requirements.text: The maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA shall be -100 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and -450 V for vehicles with 24 V systems.
requirements.reason: Table of maximum pulse amplitudes inherits the obligation of the parent.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.reason: ESA immunity test method; the bumper's electronics (radar, camera, sensors) are ESAs.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation by the method(s) as described in Annex 9.
requirements.reason: Radiated-immunity testing of the electrical/electronic sub-assemblies in the front-bumper module.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation such that test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band is as given in Table 2a.
requirements.reason: Radiated-immunity testing of the electrical/electronic sub-assemblies in the front-bumper module.

requirements.text: The ESA shall meet the test severity for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band as given in Table 2b.
requirements.reason: ESA immunity test severities apply to the bumper's electronic parts.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) described in Annex 9, with a test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band of: Stripline 20 to 400 MHz at 60 V/m; TEM cell 20 to 200 MHz at 75 V/m; BCI 20 to 400 MHz at 60 mA; ALSE 80 to 2,000 MHz at 30 V/m and 2,000 to 6,000 MHz at 10 V/m; Reverberation chamber LUF to 2,000 MHz at 21 V/m and 2,000 to 6,000 MHz at 7 V/m.
requirements.reason: ESA immunity test levels apply to the bumper's electronic parts (camera, radar, sensors); which method is used is open.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) described in Annex 9, with a minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band of: Stripline 20 to 400 MHz at 50 V/m; TEM cell 20 to 200 MHz at 62,5 V/m; BCI 20 to 400 MHz at 50 mA; ALSE 80 to 2,000 MHz at 25 V/m and 2,000 to 6,000 MHz at 8 V/m; Reverberation chamber LUF to 2,000 MHz at 18 V/m and 2,000 to 6,000 MHz at 6 V/m.
requirements.reason: Minimum test levels for ESA immunity apply to the bumper's electronic parts; the test method is open.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.reason: Pass criterion for ESA immunity testing; applies to the electronic parts of the bumper.

requirements.text: The immunity of the ESA representative of its type to transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for the starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.reason: Transient conducted immunity test method for ESA; relevant to electronic parts of the bumper.

requirements.text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.reason: Transient conducted immunity test method for ESA; relevant to electronic parts of the bumper.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.reason: Transient conducted immunity test method for ESA; relevant to electronic parts of the bumper.

requirements.text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.reason: Separately testable source-grounded requirement from the organizer development reference; conditional relevance to integrated front/side signalling lighting or bumper electronics.

requirements.text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.reason: Separately testable source-grounded requirement from the organizer development reference; conditional relevance to integrated front/side signalling lighting or bumper electronics.

requirements.text: For pulse 2a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +37 V (12V system) or +37 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.reason: Separately testable source-grounded requirement from the organizer development reference; conditional relevance to integrated front/side signalling lighting or bumper electronics.

requirements.text: For pulse 2b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +10 V (12V system) or +20 V (24V system) for 10 pulses with FPSC II for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.reason: Separately testable source-grounded requirement from the organizer development reference; conditional relevance to integrated front/side signalling lighting or bumper electronics.

requirements.text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.reason: Separately testable source-grounded requirement from the organizer development reference; conditional relevance to integrated front/side signalling lighting or bumper electronics.

requirements.text: For pulse 3b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +75 V (12V system) or +150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.reason: Separately testable source-grounded requirement from the organizer development reference; conditional relevance to integrated front/side signalling lighting or bumper electronics.

requirements.text: For the 24 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.reason: Separate 24V electronic-subassembly starting-profile obligation, relevant if the front-bumper ESA is installed in a vehicle with a 24V starter motor.

requirements.text: The loss of function of receivers during the immunity test, when the test signal is within the receiver bandwidth (RF exclusion band) as specified for the specific radio service/product in the harmonized international EMC standard, does not necessarily lead to fail criteria.
requirements.reason: Fail-criterion relaxation for receivers (e.g. keyless entry aerial) within their bandwidth during immunity test.

requirements.text: RF transmitters shall be tested in the transmit mode.
requirements.reason: RF transmitters (radar, keyless aerial) in the bumper are tested in transmit mode; spurious emissions covered.

requirements.text: Wanted emissions within the necessary bandwidth and out of band emissions are disregarded for the purpose of this Regulation, while spurious emissions are subject to this Regulation.
requirements.reason: RF transmitters (radar, keyless aerial) in the bumper are tested in transmit mode; spurious emissions covered.

requirements.text: The measurement of broadband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall, if not otherwise stated in Annex 7, be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.reason: Sets CISPR 25 as the test method for broadband emissions of ESAs such as the bumper's electronics.

requirements.text: For an ESA other than those involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.reason: Test arrangement for ESAs not involved in REESS charging, which is the likely case for the bumper electronics.

requirements.text: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.reason: Frequency range over which the emission limits apply to the ESA.

requirements.text: The measurement of radiated narrowband electromagnetic emissions of the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25, if not otherwise stated in Annex 8.
requirements.reason: Test performed per CISPR 25 for narrowband emissions of the electronic sub-assemblies.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.reason: Frequency range over which limits apply.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.reason: State of the ESA during the test.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.reason: Frequency range and modulation for the immunity test.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.reason: Frequency range and modulation for the immunity test of the ESA.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.reason: Frequency range and modulation for the immunity test of the ESA.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.reason: Frequency range and modulation for the immunity test of the ESA.

requirements.text: Immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines: test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.reason: Transient immunity test on supply lines applies to electronic ESAs in the bumper; the profile leaves power supply and control electronics unknown.

requirements.text: The starting profile according to ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines; ESAs exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to the starting profile.
requirements.reason: Transient immunity test on supply lines applies to electronic ESAs in the bumper; the profile leaves power supply and control electronics unknown.

requirements.text: Emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on the supply lines as well as on other connections of the ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.reason: Emission measurement of transients on supply lines applies to electronic ESAs in the bumper; the profile leaves power supply details unknown.

requirements.text: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
requirements.reason: General requirement on the external surface; the front bumper is part of it.

requirements.text: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.reason: General requirement on the external surface, applicable to the bumper.

requirements.text: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, except that this requirement does not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.reason: Radius of curvature limit for protruding parts of the external surface, relevant to the bumper fascia, grille and attached parts.

requirements.text: Parts of the external surface projecting between 1.5 mm and 5 mm shall have their outward-facing angles blunted, notwithstanding the exception to the minimum 2.5 mm radius of curvature for projections below 5 mm.
requirements.reason: Separate mandatory blunting condition for small protrusions on bumper fascia, grille and attached parts.

requirements.text: Protruding parts of the external surface may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm only if they are made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 shore A, the hardness measurement being taken with the component as installed on the vehicle; where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.
requirements.reason: Hardness-based exception to the radius requirement, with a measurement condition; relevant to soft parts of the bumper.

requirements.text: The requirements of paragraph 5.4 shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, only if the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.
requirements.reason: The product has a radiator grille and gaps between elements.

requirements.text: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.
requirements.reason: The product has a radiator grille and gaps between elements.

requirements.text: If the distance between two consecutive elements is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.
requirements.reason: The product has a radiator grille and gaps between elements.

requirements.text: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4 of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.reason: The product has a radiator grille and gaps between elements.

requirements.text: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.
requirements.reason: Grille elements of the bumper grille.

requirements.text: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling; this is considered satisfied if either the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork, or the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.
requirements.reason: Front bumper ends requirement.

requirements.text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.
requirements.reason: Radius of curvature on bumper rigid surface along outline contour.

requirements.text: The 5 mm provision applies to that part of the zone lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward which is situated between and in front of the tangential points with the contour line of two vertical planes each forming with the longitudinal plane of symmetry of the vehicle an angle of 15° (see Fig. 1).
requirements.reason: Radius of curvature on bumper rigid surface along outline contour.

requirements.text: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2 shall not apply to parts on or of the bumper or to bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers; but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.reason: Exemption for small parts on the bumper with blunting requirement.

requirements.text: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2 does not apply to the bumper cover, but the provisions of paragraph 5 of this Regulation remain applicable to the bumper cover.
requirements.reason: Bumper cover exempt from 6.5.2 but paragraph 5 remains applicable.

requirements.text: The projection of fuel tank filler caps and covers shall not exceed 30 mm (30 mm applies in all cases other than door or luggage compartment handles, for which 40 mm applies).
requirements.reason: Covers fuel tank filler caps and covers; the bumper has an EV charge port cap, which may be analogous.

requirements.text: Air intake and outlet flaps (e.g. in the radiator grill, where fitted) shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2., 5.3. and 5.4. of UN R26 in all positions of use.
requirements.reason: The grill may include air intake flaps; the profile does not state that flaps are present.

requirements.text: Supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of UN R26 if they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation.
requirements.reason: The bumper has a license plate area/holder.

requirements.text: The dimension of a gap or space between elements of a grille shall be determined by the distance between two planes passing through the points of contact of the sphere and perpendicular to the line joining those points of contact (see Figures 5 and 6).
requirements.reason: Method for determining grille gaps, relevant to the radiator grill.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.reason: Applies to the lighting and signalling devices integrated in the bumper (side signalling, decorative/functional lighting). Atomic obligation split; sourced from the corresponding shared regulation paragraph.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.reason: Applies to the lighting and signalling devices integrated in the bumper (side signalling, decorative/functional lighting). Atomic obligation split; sourced from the corresponding shared regulation paragraph.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that it is not possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.reason: Applies to the lighting and signalling devices integrated in the bumper (side signalling, decorative/functional lighting).

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.reason: Orientation of light-signalling devices such as side signalling lamps integrated in the bumper.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps, and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.reason: Orientation of light-signalling devices such as side signalling lamps integrated in the bumper.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with for light-signalling devices.
requirements.reason: Orientation of light-signalling devices such as side signalling lamps integrated in the bumper.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.reason: Pair lamps (e.g. left/right side signalling) must be symmetrically fitted.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.reason: Pair lamps must be symmetrical to one another.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.reason: Pair lamps colorimetric equality.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except for a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.reason: Pair lamps photometric similarity.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the front of the vehicle.
requirements.reason: Logos on lamps at the front of vehicle; bumper lighting may incorporate logos.

requirements.text: All logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited on lamps.
requirements.reason: Logos on lamps at the front of vehicle; bumper lighting may incorporate logos.

requirements.text: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another only if all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.reason: Condition for grouping/combining lamps in the bumper (decorative, signalling, functional).

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.reason: Photometric/colorimetric requirement for grouped lamps.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.reason: Photometric/colorimetric requirement for grouped lamps.

requirements.text: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.), such as lamps integrated in the front bumper, shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.reason: White light from front lamps must not be visible from the rear; the front bumper carries front-mounted lighting.

requirements.text: The position of a lamp as regards width shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width, and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps; where the position as regards width clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.reason: Measurement rule for lamp position in width; applies to the bumper's integrated lamps.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.reason: General rule on photometric stability of lamps; the bumper has integrated signalling and decorative lighting.

requirements.text: Direction-indicator lamps, the vehicle-hazard warning signal, amber side-marker lamps complying with paragraph 6.18.7., and the emergency stop signal shall be flashing lamps.
requirements.reason: Applies only if the side signalling lamps are direction-indicator or amber side-marker lamps, which is unknown.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.reason: Front bumper has side signalling lighting of unknown colour; red light visibility to front may be relevant to the vehicle installation.

requirements.text: When there is doubt, the requirement that no red light shall be emitted to the front and no white light shall be emitted to the rear shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.reason: Separately testable source-grounded requirement from the organizer development reference; conditional relevance to integrated front/side signalling lighting or bumper electronics.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.reason: Bumper integrates signalling/side lighting; electrical connection of position and side-marker lamps applies if these are fitted.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.reason: Applies to interdependent lamp systems; bumper lighting type unknown.

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.reason: Concealment of lamps prohibited generally; bumper integrates lighting.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by a front position lamp shall be White.
requirements.reason: Colour requirements for lamps; bumper has signalling and decorative lighting with unknown colours and function types.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by a direction-indicator lamp shall be Amber.
requirements.reason: Colour requirements for lamps; bumper has signalling and decorative lighting with unknown colours and function types.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by a daytime running lamp shall be White.
requirements.reason: Colour requirements for lamps; bumper has signalling and decorative lighting with unknown colours and function types.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by a side-marker lamp shall be Amber; however the rearmost side-marker lamp can be red if it is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp or is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector.
requirements.reason: Colour requirements for lamps; bumper has signalling and decorative lighting with unknown colours and function types.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.reason: General lamp-count rule; the front bumper has only decorative and side signalling lighting with unknown functions.

requirements.text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.reason: Deeming rule on lamps counted as present; it adds a condition on lamp presence for any lamps on the bumper.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1, the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.reason: Voltage limit at lamp terminals for cases not covered by 5.27.1; applies to the bumper's lighting if it is among the devices listed.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that obstacles already present when the lamp was type-approved are not taken into account.
requirements.reason: Geometric visibility of lamps; the bumper's side signalling lamps are affected by the bumper's own parts.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.reason: Lamp surface hidden by vehicle parts such as the bumper cover or grille needs proof of photometric conformity.

requirements.text: The photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal only when the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal is reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to paragraph 5.8.1).
requirements.reason: Conditional reduction of the photometric field for lamps under 750 mm; it is a condition-bound permission.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of UN R48 when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.reason: Lamps installed on the vehicle, such as the bumper's signalling lamps, must be type approved to the device Regulations.

requirements.text: Light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.reason: Applies only if the bumper's lamps incorporate a manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: Direction-indicator lamps shall be mandatory; arrangement "A" (categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 5 and 6) shall apply to all motor vehicles.
requirements.reason: Direction-indicator presence; the bumper's side signalling lighting may be a direction indicator.

requirements.text: Direction-indicator lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 6, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.reason: Type-approval of direction-indicator devices.

requirements.text: Arrangement A shall have two front direction-indicator lamps of category 1, 1a or 1b if the distance between the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the lamp and that of the dipped-beam headlamp and/or the front fog lamp, if there is one, is at least 40 mm; of category 1a or 1b if this distance is greater than 20 mm and less than 40 mm; of category 1b if this distance is less than or equal to 20 mm.
requirements.reason: Arrangement A for M1; front and side direction indicators relevant to a front bumper.

requirements.text: On M1 vehicles there shall be two side direction-indicator lamps of category 5 (minimum requirement); category 5 side direction-indicator lamps may be replaced by category 6 lamps in all instances.
requirements.reason: Arrangement A for M1; front and side direction indicators relevant to a front bumper.

requirements.text: Where lamps combining the functions of front direction-indicator lamps (categories 1, 1a, 1b) and side direction-indicator lamps (categories 5 or 6) are fitted, two additional side direction-indicator lamps (categories 5 or 6) may be fitted to meet the visibility requirements of paragraph 6.5.5.
requirements.reason: Arrangement A for M1; front and side direction indicators relevant to a front bumper.

requirements.text: The edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a direction-indicator lamp farthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.reason: Width position of direction-indicator lamps.

requirements.text: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes of the direction-indicator lamps shall not be less than 600 mm; this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.reason: Width position of direction-indicator lamps.

requirements.text: The height of the light-emitting surface of side direction-indicator lamps of categories 5 or 6 on M1 vehicles shall not be less than 350 mm, measured from the lowest point, and shall not be more than 1,500 mm, measured from the highest point.
requirements.reason: Height of side direction-indicator lamps, M1 branch.

requirements.text: The height of the direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b, measured in accordance with paragraph 5.8, shall not be less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.
requirements.reason: Height of front direction-indicator lamps.

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, the distance between the light-emitting surface of the side direction-indicator lamp (categories 5 and 6) and the transverse plane which marks the forward boundary of the vehicle's overall length shall not exceed 2,500 mm.
requirements.reason: Side direction-indicator lamp (cat. 5) longitudinal position could apply if the bumper's side signalling lighting is a side indicator; M1 branch applies.

requirements.text: Vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and below the horizontal for direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b and 5; where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.reason: Geometric visibility of direction-indicator lamps could apply to the side signalling lamp if it is a direction indicator; function unknown.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.reason: Geometric visibility of direction-indicator lamps could apply to the side signalling lamp if it is a direction indicator; function unknown.

requirements.text: At the manufacturer's discretion, for M1 category vehicles, front and rear direction indicator lamps and side-marker lamps shall have vertical angles of visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal; where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.reason: Alternative visibility angles for M1 front direction indicator and side-marker lamps; applies only if the bumper lamps are such lamps.

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, except for side direction-indicators of categories 5 and 6; the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.
requirements.reason: Alternative visibility angles for M1 front direction indicator and side-marker lamps; applies only if the bumper lamps are such lamps.

requirements.text: The orientation of direction-indicator lamps shall be according to the specifications for installation by the manufacturer, if any.
requirements.reason: Orientation of direction-indicator lamps per manufacturer installation specification; applies if bumper lamps are indicators.

requirements.text: A direction indicator capable of being activated in different modes (static or sequential) shall not switch between both modes once activated.
requirements.reason: Electrical connection rules for direction-indicator lamps; relevant only if the bumper lamps are indicators.

requirements.text: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of a vehicle shall be switched ON and OFF automatically as defined by applicable UN Regulations and/or by means of one control, and shall flash in phase.
requirements.reason: Electrical connection rules for direction-indicator lamps, relevant if the bumper integrates them.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator light shall be a flashing light flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute.
requirements.reason: Flash frequency and failure behaviour of direction-indicator lamps; applies if bumper lamps are indicators.

requirements.text: Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one second by the emission of light and within not more than one and one-half seconds by its first extinction.
requirements.reason: Flash frequency and failure behaviour of direction-indicator lamps; applies if bumper lamps are indicators.

requirements.text: All direction indicators of category 1 (1, 1a, 1b) activated simultaneously shall operate in the same mode, i.e. static or sequential.
requirements.reason: Hazard warning signal uses direction-indicator lamps; applies only if bumper lamps are indicators.

requirements.text: On M1 and N1 vehicles less than 6 m in length, with an arrangement complying with paragraph 6.5.5.2., the amber side-marker lamps, when mounted, shall also flash at the same frequency (in phase) with the direction-indicator lamps when the hazard warning signal operates.
requirements.reason: Bumper has side signalling lighting; amber side-marker lamps, if mounted on an M1, must flash with direction indicators.

requirements.text: Front position lamps shall be fitted on all motor vehicles (mandatory presence).
requirements.reason: Front position lamps are mandatory on motor vehicles; the bumper's lighting function type is unknown.

requirements.text: The number of front position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.reason: Number and type approval of front position lamps may concern bumper-integrated lighting, if present.

requirements.text: The point on the apparent surface of the front position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.reason: Position in width of front position lamps, which may be integrated in the bumper; branch for M1.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be mounted above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm for O1 and O2 categories of vehicles, or if for any other categories of vehicles the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).
requirements.reason: Mounting height of front position lamps, which may be integrated in the bumper.

requirements.text: Where the front position lamp and another lamp are reciprocally incorporated, the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the other lamp shall be used to verify compliance with the positioning requirements (paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3.).
requirements.reason: Applies where a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with another lamp, an option the profile leaves open.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the front position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards; where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.reason: Geometric visibility of front position lamps possibly integrated in the bumper.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the front position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.reason: Geometric visibility of front position lamps possibly integrated in the bumper.

requirements.text: The orientation of the front position lamp shall be forwards.
requirements.reason: Orientation of front position lamps, possibly integrated in the bumper.

requirements.text: The SM1 type of side-marker lamp shall be used on all categories of vehicles; however, the SM2 type of side-marker lamps may be used on the M1 category of vehicles.
requirements.reason: Presence rules for side-marker lamps; the bumper has side signalling lighting of unknown function, M1 branch applies.

requirements.text: On M1 category vehicles less than 6 m in length, side-marker lamps shall be used if they supplement the reduced geometric visibility requirements of front position lamps conforming to paragraph 6.9.5.2 and rear position lamps conforming to paragraph 6.10.5.2.
requirements.reason: Presence rules for side-marker lamps; the bumper has side signalling lighting of unknown function, M1 branch applies.

requirements.text: On all other vehicles side-marker lamps are optional; the SM1 or SM2 types may be used.
requirements.reason: Presence rules for side-marker lamps; the bumper has side signalling lighting of unknown function, M1 branch applies.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 91, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.reason: Number and type approval of side-marker lamps.

requirements.text: The height of a side-marker lamp above the ground shall be not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).
requirements.reason: Height position of side-marker lamps.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of a side-marker lamp shall be a horizontal angle of 45° to the front and to the rear; for vehicles on which installation of side-marker lamps is optional this value can be reduced to 30°.
requirements.reason: Geometric visibility of side-marker lamps.

requirements.text: If the vehicle is equipped with side-marker lamps used to supplement the reduced geometric visibility of front and rear direction indicator lamps conforming to paragraph 6.5.5.2 and/or position lamps conforming to paragraphs 6.9.5.2 and 6.10.5.2, the angles are 45° towards the front and rear ends of the vehicle and 30° towards the centre of the vehicle.
requirements.reason: Geometric visibility of side-marker lamps.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of a side-marker lamp shall be a vertical angle of 10° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.reason: Geometric visibility of side-marker lamps.

requirements.text: A side-marker lamp shall be oriented towards the side.
requirements.reason: Orientation of side-marker lamps.

requirements.text: On M1 category vehicles less than 6 m in length, amber side-marker lamps may be wired to flash only if the flashing is in phase and at the same frequency with the direction-indicator lamps at the same side of the vehicle.
requirements.reason: Electrical connection of side-marker lamps on M1 vehicles.

requirements.text: Daytime running lamps shall be present on motor vehicles (mandatory on motor vehicles).
requirements.reason: Daytime running lamp presence rule; the profile does not state a DRL function, only unknown functional lighting.

requirements.text: The number of daytime running lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 87, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.reason: Number and approval of DRL; the front bumper might integrate them but the profile does not say so.

requirements.text: Daytime running lamp position in width: the distance between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall not be less than 600 mm, but this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.reason: DRL position in width; may apply if the bumper integrates DRLs.

requirements.text: Daytime running lamp position in height: above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm.
requirements.reason: DRL position in height; may apply if the bumper integrates DRLs.

requirements.text: Daytime running lamp position in length: at the front of the vehicle; this requirement is deemed satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.
requirements.reason: DRL position in length; may apply if the bumper integrates DRLs.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the daytime running lamp shall be: horizontal outwards 20° and inwards 20°; vertical upwards 10° and downwards 10°.
requirements.reason: DRL geometric visibility; may apply if the bumper integrates DRLs.

requirements.text: The daytime running lamp shall be oriented towards the front.
requirements.reason: DRL orientation; may apply if the bumper integrates DRLs.

requirements.text: Conspicuity markings are prohibited on vehicles of category M1.
requirements.reason: The product is for M1 vehicles, on which conspicuity markings are prohibited.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of less than 425 mm, the requirements of paragraph 5.1.1 (flexible lower legform to bumper) shall be applied.
requirements.reason: Selects which legform-to-bumper requirement applies by lower bumper height; the front bumper is the tested part.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position greater than or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm, the requirements of either paragraph 5.1.1 or 5.1.2, at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.
requirements.reason: Selects which legform-to-bumper requirement applies by lower bumper height; the front bumper is the tested part.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position greater than or equal to 500 mm, the requirements of paragraph 5.1.2 (upper legform to bumper) shall be applied.
requirements.reason: Selects which legform-to-bumper requirement applies by lower bumper height; the front bumper is the tested part.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1 (flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.reason: Distinct, individually testable bumper pedestrian-impact performance limit under UN R127.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1 (flexible lower legform impactor), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.reason: Distinct, individually testable bumper pedestrian-impact performance limit under UN R127.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1, the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
requirements.reason: Pass/fail limits of the flexible lower legform test on the bumper.

requirements.text: The manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total only where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment does not exceed 380 Nm.
requirements.reason: Pass/fail limits of the flexible lower legform test on the bumper.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2 (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
requirements.reason: Distinct, individually testable bumper pedestrian-impact performance limit under UN R127.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2 (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
requirements.reason: Distinct, individually testable bumper pedestrian-impact performance limit under UN R127.

requirements.text: For a vehicle fitted with an ARHSS which could change the vehicle height at the front axle more than 20 mm from the nominal for any vehicle speed between 25 and 40 km/h, the provisions of paragraphs 5.1 and 5.2 shall, in addition to the normal running condition specified by the manufacturer for 40 km/h, be met for all adjustable vehicle steady heights corresponding to vehicle speeds from 25 up to 40 km/h.
requirements.reason: Applies only to vehicles with ARHSS, which changes bumper height at test; the profile leaves this open and the bumper is only indirectly concerned.

requirements.text: At the time of testing, the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a relative humidity of 40 per cent ± 30 per cent and stabilized temperature of 20 ºC ± 4 ºC.
requirements.reason: General test condition for pedestrian protection tests on the vehicle or sub-system that includes the front bumper.

requirements.text: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle (such as the pedestrian impact sensors) shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
requirements.reason: Product has pedestrian impact sensors, which are devices to protect vulnerable road users that must be active in the test.

requirements.text: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the requirements with the components in each fixed shape or position.
requirements.reason: Applies if bumper components can change shape or position with more than one fixed state; the profile leaves this open.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the lower legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.reason: Impact velocity for the lower legform bumper test.

requirements.text: The tibia bending moments of the flexible lower legform impactor shall not exceed +/- 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
requirements.reason: Limit on tibia bending moment prior to impact as a test validity condition.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor test, the selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
requirements.reason: Selection of measuring points on the bumper test area.

requirements.text: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.reason: Number and positions of lower legform to bumper tests.

requirements.text: The selected lower legform test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.reason: Number and positions of lower legform to bumper tests.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.reason: Impact velocity of the upper legform against the bumper.

requirements.text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfies the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.

requirements.text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of a unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
requirements.reason: The bumper integrates signalling/decorative lamps that may be grouped, combined or incorporated; each lamp must satisfy regulations.

requirements.text: Every light signalling device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.

requirements.text: All markings on the device (approval marking and other markings) shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.

requirements.text: The sequential number of the approval marking shall be placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.reason: Side signalling lamp may not be mountable on either side indiscriminately; arrow required if so.

requirements.text: For lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval-marking arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle for direction indicators of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12.

requirements.text: For lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval-marking arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle for front or rear position lamps and front or rear end-outline marker lamps.
requirements.reason: Arrow direction for position/end-outline/direction indicator lamps, possibly relevant to side signalling lamps. Atomic obligation split; sourced from the corresponding shared regulation paragraph.

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, a horizontal arrow showing the mounting position shall be marked and shall be directed towards the front of the vehicle in the case of direction indicators of categories 5 and 6 and combined parking lamps.
requirements.reason: Arrow marking on direction indicators/parking lamps; product has side signalling lighting of unknown function, so only doubtful.

requirements.text: If applicable, the additional letter "D" shall be marked to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.

requirements.reason: Lamp light source category marking; light sources are unknown.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear, and/or a variable luminous intensity control, and/or a secondary operating mode, and/or non-replaceable light sources.
requirements.reason: Voltage marking for lamps with electronics or non-replaceable sources; unknown for product.
