requirements.text: The light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module where replaceable light source module(s) is/are used.
requirements.reason: Conditional technical marking or design obligation for replaceable light-source modules in integrated signalling lamps; applicable only where this module design is used.

requirements.text: The specific identification code of the module shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1, in case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used.
requirements.reason: Conditional technical marking or design obligation for replaceable light-source modules in integrated signalling lamps; applicable only where this module design is used.

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) is/are used and several non-identical light source modules are used, the specific identification code of the module shall be followed by additional symbols or characters.
requirements.reason: Conditional technical marking or design obligation for replaceable light-source modules in integrated signalling lamps; applicable only where this module design is used.

requirements.text: The light source module and the lamp shall both have marks from the same applicant, where the approval mark on the light source module does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, in case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used.
requirements.reason: Conditional technical marking or design obligation for replaceable light-source modules in integrated signalling lamps; applicable only where this module design is used.

requirements.text: The light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage in case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used.
requirements.reason: Conditional technical marking or design obligation for replaceable light-source modules in integrated signalling lamps; applicable only where this module design is used.

requirements.text: The lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii) in case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used.
requirements.reason: Conditional technical marking or design obligation for replaceable light-source modules in integrated signalling lamps; applicable only where this module design is used.

requirements.text: The lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage in case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used.
requirements.reason: Conditional technical marking or design obligation for replaceable light-source modules in integrated signalling lamps; applicable only where this module design is used.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.reason: Location of approval marking on lamps.

requirements.text: The approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.reason: Visibility of marking when lamp is fitted in the bumper.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.reason: Applies if the lamp has a detachable outer lens.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.reason: Applies only if an outer lens is shared by several devices.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5.(b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.reason: Markings must be affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraph 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the light source module component.
requirements.reason: Only relevant if light source modules are used.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps carry a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number, the approval mark shall be visible after installation of the lamps.
requirements.reason: Condition on the single approval mark of grouped, combined or incorporated lamps; the product may have such lamps (signalling and decorative lighting).

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps carry a single approval mark, no part of the lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.reason: Condition on the single approval mark of grouped lamps; applies if the lamps are grouped, combined or incorporated.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.reason: Size of the marking on grouped lamps; applies if the product's lamps are grouped or combined.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5. of UN R148.
requirements.reason: General requirement for lamps submitted for approval; the bumper integrates signalling lighting.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply.
requirements.reason: Applies general specifications of other regulations to lamps, relevant for integrated signalling lamps.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.reason: Applies general specifications of other regulations to lamps, relevant for integrated signalling lamps.

requirements.text: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.reason: Lamps must stay operational under vibration; applies to integrated signalling lamps.

requirements.text: The position lamps or daytime running lamps, which are reciprocally incorporated with another function, using a common light source, and designed to operate permanently with an additional system to regulate the intensity of the light emitted, shall be permitted.
requirements.reason: Separately testable source-grounded requirement from the organizer development reference; conditional relevance to integrated front/side signalling lighting or bumper electronics.

requirements.text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.reason: Applies only if a manufacturer logo is incorporated in a lamp; option for this product.

requirements.text: The logo light emitting surface (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) shall not be required to be symmetrical by itself, notwithstanding the requirements of paragraph 5.5.2. of UN Regulation No. 48, when the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) incorporates only one manufacturer logo built by transparent or non-transparent components on request of the applicant.
requirements.reason: Conditional manufacturer-logo design exception for front light-signalling devices when a logo is incorporated.

requirements.text: The internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) shall fulfill all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation when incorporating only one manufacturer logo built by transparent or non-transparent components on request of the applicant.
requirements.reason: Separately testable source-grounded requirement from the organizer development reference; conditional relevance to integrated front/side signalling lighting or bumper electronics.

requirements.text: The internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) shall incorporate only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., when incorporating only one manufacturer logo built by transparent or non-transparent components on request of the applicant.
requirements.reason: Separately testable source-grounded requirement from the organizer development reference; conditional relevance to integrated front/side signalling lighting or bumper electronics.

requirements.text: The enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of a lamp, where the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of the lamp incorporates only one manufacturer logo built by transparent or non-transparent components on request of the applicant, shall not exceed 100 cm2 in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.reason: Separately testable source-grounded requirement from the organizer development reference; conditional relevance to integrated front/side signalling lighting or bumper electronics.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.reason: Applies to lamps with multiple light sources; light sources unknown for this product.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and, when all light sources are illuminated, the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced, in which case the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.reason: Failure provision for multi-source lamps; may apply to integrated lamps.

requirements.text: For direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12, instead of paragraph 4.6.1.2. and in addition to paragraph 4.6.1.1., a signal for activation of the tell-tale prescribed in paragraph 6.5.8. of Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 6.3.8. of Regulation No. 53 shall be produced on the basis of either option (a) any one light source has failed; (b) in the case of a lamp designed for only two light sources, the intensity in the axis of reference is less than 50 per cent of the minimum intensity required; or (c) as a consequence of a failure of one or more light sources, the intensity in one of the directions H=0°, V=0°; H=20° outwards to the outside of the vehicle, V=+5°; H=10° inwards to the inside of the vehicle, V=0° (Annex 3, paragraph 2.1.) is less than the minimum intensity required.
requirements.reason: Applies only to direction-indicator lamps; the bumper's side signalling lamp type is unknown.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with: replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.reason: Applies to integrated signalling/decorative lamps whose light sources are unknown.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.reason: Applies if the lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources, which the profile leaves open.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061; the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applies, and where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) applies.
requirements.reason: Applies if the lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources, which the profile leaves open.

requirements.text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.reason: The bumper integrates signalling lighting, possibly with electronics, so the EMC requirement applies.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module(s) can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
requirements.reason: Conditional technical marking or design obligation for replaceable light-source modules in integrated signalling lamps; applicable only where this module design is used.

requirements.text: The design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module(s) can only be removed with the use of tool(s) in case of replaceable light source module(s).
requirements.reason: Conditional technical marking or design obligation for replaceable light-source modules in integrated signalling lamps; applicable only where this module design is used.

requirements.text: The design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module(s) is tamperproof in case of replaceable light source module(s).
requirements.reason: Conditional technical marking or design obligation for replaceable light-source modules in integrated signalling lamps; applicable only where this module design is used.

requirements.text: The design of the light source module(s) shall be such that regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module(s) is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.reason: Conditional technical marking or design obligation for replaceable light-source modules in integrated signalling lamps; applicable only where this module design is used.

requirements.text: When the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, in case of replaceable light source module(s), the device shall meet the photometric requirements.
requirements.reason: Conditional technical marking or design obligation for replaceable light-source modules in integrated signalling lamps; applicable only where this module design is used.

requirements.text: The lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) shall have all measurements made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.reason: Source-grounded, separately testable general lamp verification requirement for integrated bumper signalling lamps.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined; however, in the case of category 5 and 6 direction indicators, the limits of the light emitting surface shall be determined; this requirement shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps.
requirements.reason: Apparent surface determination for light-signalling lamps; the bumper has signalling lamps.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the lamp shall be operated for testing at a supply voltage at the lamp of 6.75 V (6 Volt systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt systems) or 28 V (24 Volt systems).
requirements.reason: Source-grounded, separately testable general lamp verification requirement for integrated bumper signalling lamps.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.reason: Photometric requirements for lamps; the bumper integrates signalling lighting whose function is unknown.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall in no direction where the lamp is visible exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.reason: Photometric requirements for lamps; the bumper integrates signalling lighting whose function is unknown.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5 by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.reason: Photometric requirements for lamps; the bumper integrates signalling lighting whose function is unknown.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.

requirements.text: To verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No.48, where the applicant requests an additional test, the maximum intensity in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction shall be not more than 2.5∙10-1 cd; this test may be conducted taking into account the influence of the vehicle body.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of a front position lamp (A, MA) or front end-outline marker lamp (AM) shall meet the luminous intensity and standard light distribution requirements in Table 3.

requirements.text: Front position lamps and front end-outline marker lamps of categories A, MA or AM shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4∙10^0 cd and a maximum luminous intensity of 1.40∙10^2 cd for a single lamp and 7.0∙10^1 cd for a lamp marked "D", with standard light distribution according to Figure A3-I and angles of geometric visibility according to Table A2-1, with a minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility of 5∙10^-2 cd.
requirements.reason: Table values for front position lamps, inherited from 5.1.1.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by a front position lamp (A) or front end-outline marker lamp (AM) shall be white; the lamp identified by symbol MA may be amber.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by a daytime running lamp shall be white.

requirements.reason: Luminous intensity requirement for direction indicators; the bumper's signalling lamp function is unknown.

requirements.reason: Table values for direction indicator intensities; the profile does not say which category applies, so all are listed.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 the flash may be produced by sequential activation of their light sources only if each light source, after its activation, remains lit until the end of the ON cycle.

requirements.text: For sequential activation of the light sources of direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12, the sequence of activation shall produce a signal which proceeds in a uniform progressive manner from inboard towards the outboard edge of the light emitting surface.
requirements.reason: Conditions for sequential flash of direction indicators, if the bumper has such lamps.

requirements.text: For sequential direction indicators, the signal shall be one signal with no interruption and no vertical oscillations (e.g. not more than one change of direction along the vertical axis); the distance between two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the light emitting surface shall not exceed 50 mm, when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, instead of the values defined in paragraph 5.7.2 of UN Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 5.7.2 of UN Regulation No. 86 or paragraph 5.6.2 of UN Regulation No. 53; these interruptions of the signal shall not create any overlap in the vertical axis between the different parts, from inboard towards the outboard of the vehicle, and shall not be used for any other lighting or light signalling functions.

requirements.text: For sequential direction indicators, the variation shall finish no more than 200 ms after the beginning of the ON cycle.
requirements.reason: Conditions for sequential flash of direction indicators, if the bumper has such lamps.

requirements.text: For sequential direction indicators, the orthogonal projection of the light emitting surfaces in the direction of the axis of reference shall be circumscribed by a rectangle on a plane normal to the axis of reference and having its longer sides parallel to the H-plane, and the ratio of the horizontal to the vertical sides shall not be less than 1.7.

requirements.reason: Side signalling lighting of unknown function may be a side marker lamp.

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, mathematically rounded down to three significant digits; the direction H = 0° and V = 0° corresponds to the reference axis and passes through the centre of reference.
requirements.reason: General photometric rule for signalling lamps; the front bumper integrates signalling lighting whose function type is unknown.

requirements.text: Where a front direction indicator lamp, front position lamp, front end-outline marker lamp, parking lamp or side marker lamp is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.reason: General photometric rule for signalling lamps; the front bumper integrates signalling lighting whose function type is unknown.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light pattern shall be substantially uniform, i.e. the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.reason: General light-pattern uniformity rule for lamps, applicable to signalling lamps in the bumper.

requirements.text: The light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage, within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid.
requirements.reason: Separately testable source-grounded requirement from the organizer development reference; conditional relevance to integrated front/side signalling lighting or bumper electronics.

requirements.text: Front position lamps, parking lamps, front end-outline marker lamps and direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12 shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8) given in Figure A3-I.
requirements.reason: Standard light distribution for front position, parking, end-outline and direction indicator lamps, which a bumper's signalling lighting might be.

requirements.text: Daytime running lamps shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensity required (see Table 6) given in Figure A3-II.
requirements.reason: Functional front lighting type is unknown; daytime running lamps could be integrated in a front bumper.

requirements.text: Direction indicator lamps of category 6 shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensity required (see Table 8) given in Figure A3-IV, where the direction H = 5° and V = 0° corresponds to the minimum value prescribed in Table 8.
requirements.reason: Side signalling lighting on the bumper could be a side direction indicator; its function is unknown.

requirements.text: Side marker lamps of category SM1 shall meet the light distribution given in Figure A3-VII.
requirements.reason: Side marker lamp distribution; applies if the side signalling lighting is an SM1 side marker lamp.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with when tested under the conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.reason: Chromaticity compliance in CoP for the lamps; the lighting colours are unknown.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of mass-produced lamps shall be complied with when tested under the conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.reason: Colour conformity requirement for lamps in CoP.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, for all lamps other than reversing and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.reason: Applies to all other lamps with non-incandescent light sources, e.g. the side signalling lighting, if one is fitted and approved under this regulation.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution shall, depending on the light source technology and in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1, where the luminous intensity distributions at a point in time may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured according to paragraph 1 by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at the reference coordinate of the lamp (function) under consideration.
requirements.reason: Separately testable source-grounded requirement from the organizer development reference; conditional relevance to integrated front/side signalling lighting or bumper electronics.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution of a direction indicator lamp of Category 1, 2, 11 or 12 shall be checked for compliance 0.2 seconds after switch ON at HV.
requirements.reason: Table of switch-on times for the additional checks; the bumper's lamp functions are not specified.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution of a daytime running lamp shall be checked for compliance 4 seconds after switch ON at HV.
requirements.reason: Table of switch-on times for the additional checks; the bumper's lamp functions are not specified.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution of a side marker lamp shall be checked for compliance 4 seconds after switch ON at HV.
requirements.reason: Table of switch-on times for the additional checks; the bumper's lamp functions are not specified.
